name: Disulfiram
effects: Aldehyde dehydrogenase inhibitor — causes acetaldehyde accumulation when alcohol is consumed
Disulfiram-ethanol reaction: flushing, nausea, vomiting, hypotension, tachycardia — can be severe
Mild CNS effects at high doses; psychosis reported rarely
Inhibits CYP2E1 — interactions with isoniazid, metronidazole, cocaine
Alcohol-containing products (mouthwash, sauces) can trigger reaction
